title.rendered: 12:00pm – Thursday Update – Air Quality & Student Activities

content.rendered:
The air quality in Sherwood is now within the moderate range which allows for us to resume outdoor activities including recess, PE, and after school games and practices.

Students that are “unusually sensitive to air pollution” may need to limit activity or remain inside.


Earlier message:  Due to air quality concerns the district has cancelled or moved inside all outside recess and activities during the school day. In addition a decision regarding after school and evening outdoor activities will be made by 1 pm.
